name: Premium Display Build
description: Adult builder seeking the most complex, impressive Technic set as a display-worthy engineering masterpiece. Willing to invest $400+ for the ultimate building experience and a showpiece for their collection shelf.

name: Gift for a Car Lover
description: Buying a gift for someone who loves cars, motorsport, or specific automotive brands. Needs guidance on what's impressive, what's new, and what fits their budget — from $65 to $230.

name: Father's Day Gift
description: Looking for a premium, meaningful Father's Day gift that combines engineering, quality time, and a display-worthy result. Sets that feel special, not just another gadget.

name: Weekend Build Project
description: Solo builder looking for a challenging but completable weekend project. Wants something satisfying that takes 4-10 hours — complex enough to be engaging but not so large it takes weeks.

name: Brand Fan Collectible
description: Die-hard fan of a specific F1 team or car brand who wants the official licensed LEGO set of their team. Collects by brand loyalty — McLaren fan wants all McLaren sets, Ferrari fan wants the full Scuderia collection.

name: F1 Season Follower
description: Active F1 fan following the current season who wants to build the car of their favorite driver or team. Motivated by race weekends, driver rivalries, and championship battles.
